records.title: PERSONNEL DISCREPANCY
pages:
BOTH STATEMENTS ARE SIGNED.
NEITHER HAS BEEN WITHDRAWN.

records.title: REPORT 9
pages:
WE TRIED DESTROYING
THE PARTITION.
IT REPAIRED ITSELF.

WE TRIED SEALING THE DOORS.
THE DOORS APPEARED ELSEWHERE.

WE TRIED SENDING A MAN THROUGH.
HE RETURNED SIX HOURS LATER.

HE REMEMBERED EVERYTHING.
HE REMEMBERED THE ACCIDENT.
HE REMEMBERED THE BURIAL.

HE REMEMBERED US STANDING
OVER HIS GRAVE.

WE HAVE NOT DETERMINED
WHICH ONE WAS WRONG.

records.title: ON COPIES
pages:
A COPY IS NOT A DUPLICATE.
A DUPLICATE IS MADE.

A COPY IS FOUND,
ALREADY THERE,
WAITING TO BE NOTICED.

records.title: ON MEMORY
pages:
SUBJECTS WHO RETURN
REMEMBER BOTH VERSIONS.

THEY DO NOT PREFER ONE.
THEY DO NOT NOTICE.
